raw_text: hyd leak on the main cyl again, 3rd time this qtr. found the seal on rod side blown. replced seal kit + topped up oil. down abt 95 min. RECOMEND we change the whole cyl at next shutdwn, seals keep going becuse rod is scored
roll gap sensor readin garbage. swapped the LVDT, recalibrated. 40min. sensor was full of scale dust, the cover gasket is missing - somebody lost it
conveyour belt tracking off to the drive side, rubbing frame. adjusted the snub pulley. ~55min. belt edge already damaged maybe 8m of it. needs vulcanizing next window
cooling water flow low alarm on stave 14. strainer blocked w/ debris. cleaned + back in service 70 min. this is the 2nd stave strainer this week, i think somethng is shedding upstream in the header
main drive motor tripped on overcurrent. checked meggar OK. found the cooling fan on the drive cabinet siezed so VFD was overtemp and derating. replaced fan 60min, run up fine

hydralic pwr unit pressure droppin. pump 2 not making pressure, couplin elastomer shredded. swapped coupling element. 50 mins. NB pump 2 has done 3 couplings in 6 months - alignment check needed, i think base plate is soft
thermocouple on tuyere 8 open circuit. replaced TC + extension cable. 35 min
gearbox on the sinter fan runnin hot, 92c on the brg. oil level was low, topped up. also found breather cap clogged. 45min. reccomend oil analysis, there was a bit of metal on the mag plug
same hyd leak main cyl HRM-01. rod side seal. did seal kit again. 85min. as i said before the rod is scored, this will keep repeating until cyl is changed. escalated to eng
mould oscillator vibration high. found loose foundation bolts, 4 of them. torqued to spec. 75 min. whole frame needs re-grouting imo
coilr tension out of range. load cell drifting. recalibrated, held for now but cell is old. 30min. suggest replace at outage
cooling water low flow stave 6. strainer again full of rubber bits. cleaned. 65min. the rubber is coming from somewhere - expansion joint liner maybe. NEEDS investigatn, 3rd one this month
belt slippin on the drive pulley, lagging worn smooth. couldnt fix properly, tensioned as temp fix. 40min. NOT RESOLVED - needs re-lagging, raised WO
segment roll seized, bearing collapsed. changed the roll assy. 180min. big job. bearing had no grease - autolube line was crimped where it passes the frame
VFD fault F0023 undervoltage. supply side, found loose terminal on the incoming isolator. retorqued all. 55min
hyd oil temp high. cooler fouled on water side. flushed it. 60 min. water side treatment needs looking at, scale build up is fast
stockline probe stuck, wont retract. mech binding in the guide, cleaned + lubed. 50min
sinter fan gearbox brg temp high again 95c. oil analysis came back bad, water in oil. drained + refilled, changed breather. 110min. root cause is the cooler leaking into the oil side i think
oscillator vibration again on CC-01. foundation bolts loose AGAIN. this is the grout, its cracked. torqued + logged. 70min. RECOMMEND full re-grout, will keep coming back
descaler nozzle blocked, 3 of them. rodded out + flushed hdr. 45min. filter on the descale pump needs shorter change interval
main cyl replaced at weekend shutdwn finally. commisioned + tested, no leaks. 240 min planned work. rod was badly scored as expected
stave cooling low flow, strainer blocked, rubber again. cleaned. 60min. i opened the expansion joint upstream and the liner is definately shredding. reported to eng, this is the source
tension load cell failed completly now. replaced. 90min. shouldve been done at outage like i said in jan
belt re-lagged during window. tensioned + tracked. 300min planned. resolved the slip issue from jan

segment roll bearing noisy. checked autolube, another crimped line same spot as last time. changed hose routing + re-greased. 95min. the routing thru the frame is a design problem, all segments are like this
work roll chock not clamping. hyd clamp solenoid coil burnt. swapped coil. 40min
TC tuyere 3 reading low then open circuit. replaced. 30 min. thats 4 TCs this qtr, all on the south side. maybe the cable tray runs too close to the hot face there

HPU pump 2 coupling gone AGAIN. 3rd in 6 mo + this one. did laser alignment this time, base plate IS soft, found 2 loose holding down bolts and the epoxy chocking is broken up. temp fix, torqued + new element. 120min. NOT PROPERLY RESOLVED needs re-chocking
gearbox oil cooler confirmed leaking, water in oil. isolated cooler, running on aux for now. 80min. cooler on order. NOT RESOLVED
mould level control unstable, eddy current sensor coated in slag. cleaned sensor face. 35min
descale nozzles blocked again 5 of them. rodded. 50 min. filter interval was NOT changed, still 4 weeks. this is why
gas cleaning plant dp high, scrubber nozzle partly blocked. cleaned 2 nozzles. 75min
strip break detector giving false trips. photocell dirty + misaligned. cleaned + realigned. 25min
segment 7 roll bearing failed, seized. roll change. 190min. autolube line crimped, same frame pass-through issue. THIS IS THE 3RD ONE. needs the routing redesign, im logging it again
new gearbox oil cooler fitted. flushed system, new oil, oil analysis clean. 210min planned. resolved
drive cabinet overtemp again. 2nd fan failed, the one i didnt change in jan. replaced both remaining fans. 70min. these fans are all same age, suggest replace as a set on the other cabinets too
stave cooling low flow. strainer. rubber bits. cleaned. 55min. expansion joint STILL not replaced, eng have the report since 3rd feb
hyd oil temp high, cooler water side scaled again. flushed. 65min. 2nd time in 5 weeks, water treatment issue not addressed
oscillator vibr high, foundation. re-grout done at weekend actually so this time it was a loose drive coupling. retorqued. 60min
roll chock clamp slow. hyd accumulator pre-charge low, recharged N2. 45min
expansion joint liner finally replaced in shutdown. also cleaned all stave strainers. 320min planned. should stop the repeat strainer blockages
sinter cooler fan bearing noise, grease gun used, noise reduced but still there. temp fix. 40min. NOT RESOLVED, bearing needs change, WO raised
HPU base plate re-chocked in shutdown, laser aligned. 280 min planned. pump 2 coupling issue should be finished now
mould level eddy current sensor coated again. cleaned. 30min. cleaning interval should be weekly not monthly
descale nozzle blocked x2. rodded. 35min. filter interval finally changed to 2 wks from this week
TC tuyere 11 open ckt, south side again. replaced + rerouted cable away from hot face as trial. 55min. lets see if this one lasts
sinter cooler fan brg replaced. 160min. resolved
strip break detector false trip. photocell dirty. cleaned. 20min. 2nd time, the air purge on the photocell housing is blocked, thats the real cause. cleared purge line too
segment autolube routing redesign fitted on seg 5,6,7. no more crimping. 240min planned. hopefully end of the bearing failures
drive cabinet temp OK now with new fans. this call was actually a false alarm, RTD loose in terminal. retightened. 25min
stockline probe binding. cleaned guide + lubed. 45min. 2nd time on BF-01, the guide needs a proper seal to keep dust out
emulsion pump flow low, suction filter blocked. changed filter element. 30min
conveyor belt tracking off, snub pulley adjusted. 45min. this is the belt we vulcanized in jan, the repair patch is lifting on one edge
tundish car drive not moving, limit switch failed. replaced LS. 50min
small weep on main cyl gland - new cyl. nipped up the gland nut, watching it. 20min. probably just bedding in
